accepted_properties: Equivalent explicit traces normalize deterministically and produce stable trace and replay-plan digests independent of input order.
Replay ordering is bound to explicit event sequence and generation identity.
Physical-only events are preserved as explicit T4 fidelity gaps and are never replayed as T3 events or granted physical-host credit.
Unknown event semantics remain explicit UNKNOWN fidelity gaps rather than being promoted to replayable facts.
Generation regression, duplicate sequence identity, duplicate event identity, non-allowlisted or privacy-forbidden content, malformed profile digests, and untyped physical-gap reasons fail closed.
not_evidenced: T3 target trace capture or replay on a VPS or physical target host
next_exact_action: Use this accepted deterministic trace/replay primitive only after the current target-VPS exact-source hygiene fence is satisfied: preserve the dirty workspace, create a clean exact-source worktree/container bound to an admitted F2 commit, capture only allowlisted technical host events, and issue a separate identity-bound runtime receipt.
